features.acceptance: Curriculum comparison, public undergraduate directory, workspace home, and current student services behavior remain at the newest remote develop versions.

The student services route links to official UPTC sources for UPTC Conecta, SIRA/Campus Virtual, student subject-registration options, and the undergraduate calendar without capturing credentials or personal academic data.
The initial public undergraduate directory load error is exposed through an accessible alert and covered by an AAA regression test.
Frontend tests, lint, build, and CI pass before its fast-forward push to origin/develop.
Backend develop points to the published frontend develop SHA and backend CI passes before its fast-forward push.
Both GitHub remotes expose only refs/heads/develop.
Old worktrees remain unchanged; generated, obsolete, or conflicting changes are reviewed individually before any further integration.
